jobs.title: Affiliate Marketing Project Manager / Executive Admin
jobs.description:
About Clutch Affiliate

Clutch Affiliate is a women\-owned affiliate and partnership marketing agency working with CPG and DTC brands across Amazon, DTC/network affiliate, publisher affiliate, TikTok Shop, and PR affiliate. With remote offices in Tampa, Florida and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, we run lean and move fast, both with our clients and with each other. If you like clear ownership over your work and don't want corporate red tape, you'll fit in here.

The Role

We're looking for a Project Manager / Admin who can be the connective tissue across Clutch. This role oversees the moving pieces across our full client roster and supports our co\-founders directly, keeping projects, deadlines, and next steps on track internally and with clients. You'll need to be organized, proactive, and comfortable owning the details other people forget to track.

This is not primarily an affiliate marketing execution role. Affiliate marketing knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement, we're happy to train that piece. What matters most is that you're a sharp project manager and administrator who can keep multiple clients and workstreams moving without being told twice.

We're not currently tied to a specific project management platform. If you have strong experience with a PM tool you love (Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Notion, or otherwise) and think it would serve us well, we're genuinely open to adopting it.

If it's a mutual fit, there's real room to grow into full\-time as our client base expands.

What You'll Do

\- Serve as the central point of organization across all client accounts, tracking deliverables, deadlines, and next steps

\- Provide direct administrative support to Clutch's co\-founders, managing schedules, priorities, and follow\-through

\- Keep internal projects on track, flagging what's falling behind before it becomes a problem

\- Coordinate across the team to make sure client needs are being met on time

\- Build and maintain systems (trackers, checklists, calendars) that keep the agency organized as it scales

\- Sit in on client calls as needed to capture next steps and keep projects moving

\- Support affiliate program operations where needed (we'll train you on this as it comes up)

\- Bring ideas to the table on how to make Clutch run more efficiently, not just execute on someone else's

What You Need

\- Strong project management skills, comfortable juggling multiple clients and priorities at once

\- Excellent organizational skills and follow\-through, nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

\- Comfortable providing high\-level administrative support to founders

\- Self\-starter energy. We're not going to micromanage you; we need someone who sees what needs doing and does it

\- Clear, confident communicator, both internally and with clients

\- Genuine interest in helping a small agency run well and grow

Nice to Have

\- Familiarity with affiliate/publisher marketing (CJ, Avantlink, AWIN, or Impact)

\- PR affiliate experience

\- Experience with a PM platform you'd advocate for us adopting

Hours and Structure

Flexible and remote. Potential to expand to full\-time based on performance and agency growth.

Pay

Hourly, based on experience.

To Apply

To help us see who reads instructions carefully, please include the following when you apply:

1\. In your cover letter or application message, name one podcast episode Clutch Affiliate has appeared on (you'll find this on our website at www.clutchaffiliate.com).

2\. Include the phrase "Growth Partner" somewhere in your subject line or application message.

Applications that skip these steps will not be considered.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

The Sage X3 Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Sage Intacct implementations for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence, building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long\-term value.

* Monitor project progress and proactively adjust plans to meet client expectations.

* Lead project closure meetings and coordinate seamless transitions to post\-implementation support teams.
* Document lessons learned and contribute insights to continuous improvement initiatives and best practices.

* Contribute to process analysis, redesign initiatives, and organizational effectiveness efforts to drive continuous improvement and scalability.

* Proven success managing end\-to\-end ERP projects within Process Manufacturing or Distribution Manufacturing.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time, within budget, and in scope, supported by a strong project management foundation.
* Solid understanding of ERP concepts; experience in process manufacturing or distribution manufacturing desired.
* Proven track record of achieving business objectives and meeting key performance metrics.
* Bachelor’s degree required.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**
ChowNow is one of the leading players in off\-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support **thousands of** **restaurants across North America**, helping process **$1B\+ in gross food sales** while saving our partners over **$700M in third\-party commission fees**. Through our white\-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner\-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, **Kanika Soni**. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting\-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

**About the Position:**
We're looking for a strategic, AI and data\-driven Senior Revenue Enablement Program Manager to accelerate the performance of our Revenue organization. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross\-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.


Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management's strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

**Responsibilities**


Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

* **Project \& Timeline Management:** Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
* **Product \& Cross‑Functional Leadership:** Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R\&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
* **Advanced Risk Management:** Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
* Typically 7–10\+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

**Technical Skills**

* Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

**Management Skills**

* **Detail‑Oriented:** Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
* **Communication:** Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
* **Problem‑Solving:** Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
* **Cross‑Functional Fluency:** Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
* **Adaptability \& Ambiguity:** Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Mediator, not Participant:** Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
* **Conflict Navigation:** Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
* **Calm in the Storm:** Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
* **Attention to Detail:** Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

**Pay and Benefits**  

  

US$130,000\.00 \- US$140,000\.00 Annually

Employees in this role are eligible to participate in the company's benefits program, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, accrued vacation, floating holidays, and designated company holidays.

jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people\-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.


Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.


**Make an impact — from near or far**


At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.


We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.


**The opportunity**


The Information Security Risk Analyst supports the identification, assessment, and monitoring of information security and privacy\-related risks to help safeguard the University's systems, data, and operations. This role contributes to SNHU's information security risk management program through the application of qualitative and quantitative evaluation of threats, vulnerabilities, and security control effectiveness across systems, vendors, technologies, and business processes.


The Analyst performs risk analyses, maintains accurate risk records within the GRC platform, supports vulnerability and remediation tracking, participates in risk assessments, and contributes to risk reporting and program improvement activities. This role works collaboratively within the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function, partnering with information security, compliance, audit, privacy, and business stakeholders to ensure risk management activities align with regulatory requirements, institutional policies, organizational priorities, and industry best practices. You will report to the Senior Manager of Information Security Risk and Compliance.


\#LI\-Remote


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Conduct qualitative and quantitative information security risk assessments across systems, vendors, technologies, and business processes to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and control gaps affecting the University's information security risk posture.
* Maintain accurate risk records, artifacts, and supporting documentation within the University's GRC platform to ensure consistency, quality, and compliance with established risk management processes.
* Collaborate with information security, privacy, compliance, audit, and business stakeholders to coordinate and document risk mitigation activities and track remediation efforts in alignment with regulatory requirements, risk management frameworks, institutional policies, and organizational priorities.
* Analyze and monitor security risks and prepare risk metrics and reports that support ongoing risk visibility and decision\-making.
* Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of information security risk management and compliance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models that strengthen the University's security and privacy posture.
* Collaborate with GRC leaders to support risk awareness and education initiatives through the identification of key human and organizational risk drivers and the promotion of risk\-informed behaviors required to mitigate them.
* Monitor changes in cybersecurity threats, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, and apply relevant knowledge to support the ongoing effectiveness and maturity of the University's information security risk management program.
* Other job duties as assigned.

**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of experience in a related field
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience supporting information security risk management activities for a large enterprise
* Working knowledge of NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and other common information security risk management practices and frameworks
* Familiarity with higher education industry standards and regulations (e.g. GLBA, FERPA)
* Experience conducting or supporting risk assessments, tracking remediation activities, and maintaining risk records
* Experience analyzing cybersecurity risks, preparing risk\-related documentation and communicating effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Working knowledge of information security governance, policies, standards, and industry best practices

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion \- where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.


**Compensation**


The annual pay range for this position is $70,729\.00 \- $113,188\.00\. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $78,155\.00 \- $105,739\.00\.
**Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)**


You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full\-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:


* High\-quality, low\-deductible medical insurance
* Low to no\-cost dental and vision plans
* 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)
* Employer\-funded retirement
* Free tuition program
* Parental leave
* Mental health and wellbeing resources

*Reassignment Applicants*: Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

**DESCRIPTION**
===============

**DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW:**


The Mission of the San Diego Supercomputer Center is to translate innovation into practice. SDSC adopts and partners on innovations in industry and academia in the areas of software, hardware, computational and data sciences, and related areas, and translates them into cyberinfrastructure that solves practical problems across any and all scientific domains and societal endeavors. Cyberinfrastructure refers to an accessible, integrated network of high\-performance computing, data, and networking resources and expertise, focused on accelerating scientific inquiry and discovery. With more than 250 employees and $30\-50M of revenue a year, SDSC is a global leader in the design, development, and operations of cyberinfrastructure.


SDSC supports hundreds of multidisciplinary programs spanning a wide variety of domains, from earth sciences and biology to astrophysics, bioinformatics, and health IT. SDSC presently operates multiple large HPC systems ranging from a 120k x86 CPU core general purpose system to a system explicitly designed for Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, and a nationally distributed system open for all of academia to integrate with. SDSC offers research data services across the entire vertical stack from universally scalable storage to consulting services on FAIR, Big Data, and AI. SDSC offers a rich set of cloud services both on\-premise, in the commercial cloud, and as hybrid services across both.


SDSC has three geographic scopes, a national scope supporting cyberinfrastructure for the entire US research and education community, a California scope with a special focus on convergence research that addresses the three dominant threats to CA: Drought, Fire, Earthquakes, and a campus scope focusing on advancing the global impact of SDSC by advancing the research objectives of the UC San Diego faculty, researchers, and students.


SDSC impacts researchers at scales from 1,000’s to Millions. SDSC annually trains thousands of researchers in cyberinfrastructure tools and software, and supports thousands of individual researchers via Unix accounts on its large HPC systems. SDSC was a leader developing the Science Gateway concept, and continues to be a global leader in its evolution. SDSC operates multiple major such gateways with user communities ranging from the tens of thousands to the millions. SDSC’s educational programs include online courses that have been attended by more than a million students.


SDSC is committed to democratizing access to cyberinfrastructure across all of its geographic scopes. SDSC strives towards a culture that supports our employees to be their best, achieve their goals, and enjoy their lives, both professionally and personally.


Prof. Tim Mackey operates a public health data science lab situated at SDSC. This lab is interdisciplinary and is funded by state and Federal grants, exploring topics including Infodemiology, data science and health topics, and health policy.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
======================

**This is a 50% part\-time Career position.**


The Research Data Analyst works on research data reporting assignments that are of moderate diversity in scope and exercises judgment within generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions.


The Research Data Analyst will provide technical, research, and analytical skills along with applied programming, data modeling and data management in support of federally funded and extramural grant projects. Specifically, the position will require statistical, computational, and data analysis work on internal and external research grants that involve analysis of both structured and unstructured data. The incumbent applies data, programming, systems engineering, and information management concepts to conducting scientific research for healthcare, public health, and data science projects, works on data of moderate scope and complexity where analyses of situations or data require a review of a variety of factors and participates in the creation and implementation of applied mathematical models analyzing structured and unstructured data, building data collection and management applications, translating findings to research results, and developing manuscripts and abstracts for scientific presentation. Additionally, the Research Data Analyst designs and implements capture of metadata from technical processes such as machine learning, deep learning, topic models, natural language processing, and database management, extracts data from multiple data sources and integrates with other secondary data layers and other sources as well as analyzes and models data with the aim to provides actionable insights to collaborating teams to aid processes within the institution and will also work on visualization projects to create institutional and research\-based dashboard development.


For more information, please visit: https://www.sdsc.edu/

 **ROLE OVERVIEW**



The Data Analyst will provide data driven recommendations to support the operations and growth of ALOHA Collection. This role will be responsible for collaborating with internal partners and unlocking reporting and analysis capabilities for each team. Day\-to\-day work will consist of addressing data related queries from stakeholders by creating data products such as dashboards, reports, analysis, and automation. This role offers the flexibility of being hybrid (Carlsbad, CA) or fully remote.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Query and analyze data using SQL to track marketing KPIs and assess business health, using AI tools to accelerate query writing, exploration, and pattern\-finding.
* Design, develop, and continuously improve impactful and dynamic reporting and visualizations — including interactive dashboards and AI\-generated artifacts — that provide clear, actionable insights into product performance, operational efficiency, and company trends.
* Support and help enforce data governance standards — including consistent metric definitions, naming conventions, access, and documentation — so teams work from reliable, well\-understood data and decisions are built to scale as the business grows.
* Own regular data sweeps and audits, ensuring records are accurate, complete, and consistent, and partnering with relevant teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.
* Apply strong judgment to validate and quality\-check AI\-assisted analysis and outputs, ensuring accuracy and sound interpretation before insights are shared or acted on.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert, providing training and ongoing guidance to teams using data and AI tools to make decisions.
* Champion AI adoption across the organization: identify high\-value use cases, build and share reusable prompts, workflows, and artifacts, and coach teams on effective, responsible use.
* Lead and manage ad\-hoc reporting requests and analysis, using AI to increase speed and depth of turnaround.
* Implement and support continuous improvement in data analytics, business intelligence, and reporting efficiency and effectiveness, including integrating AI and automation into recurring workflows.


**EXPERIENCE WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* 2\+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or related field
* Experience in retail or E\-commerce industries a must
* Strong proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Omni, PowerBI, etc.)
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and problem\-solving — with the judgment to validate outputs for accuracy before relying on them
* Expert level in Google Sheets


**WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE**


* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and concise manner to all levels of the organization
* Strong analytical skills including attention to detail and independent problem solving
* A natural curiosity and intuition for data — ability to create models/frameworks to break down complex problems without fully defined requirements and questions
* Enthusiasm for helping others adopt data tools; comfort coaching and enabling non\-technical teammates


**WHAT WE OFFER**



From the start, our founders, Heather and Rachael, envisioned a company culture that was dynamic, intentional and sustainable. We provide education about Hawaiian culture and opportunities for personal and professional growth for every member of Team ALOHA. We believe in work\-life balance and trust, which is why we offer flexible remote working options and show up with compassion when life's unexpected moments arise. And if you haven't heard, we LOVE working together!


**Benefits**


* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance


**Schedule**


* Full\-Time, Monday \- Friday
* Hybrid \| Offices in Carlsbad, CA
* Must be legally eligible to work in the United States


**Pay**


* $80,000 \- $95,000

**We're excited to review your resume.**


**MAHALO!**

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!


Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description** **THE POSITION:**

The D365 Business / Functional Analyst supports the D365 Finance \& Operations ERP platform, helping translate business needs into practical system solutions while providing day\-to\-day functional support. This role works closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners to support requirements gathering, configuration, testing, releases, and continuous improvement across the ERP environment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

* Business Partnership \& Functional Leadership
	+ Work with Finance, Supply Chain, Project Management \& Accounting, and operational stakeholders to understand business needs.
	+ Participate in requirements gathering, solution discussions, and process reviews.
	+ Translate business requirements into user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
	+ Apply D365 best practices when evaluating business processes and potential solutions.
* Functional Solution Design \& Configuration
	+ Support functional design and configuration across D365 F\&O modules, including Finance, Supply Chain, and Project Management \& Accounting.
	+ Configure D365 to support business processes while following standard functionality and minimizing unnecessary customizations.
	+ Help define functional requirements for extensions, integrations, workflows, and reports.
	+ Work with developers and implementation partners to ensure solutions meet documented business requirements.
* Day\-to\-Day ERP Support
	+ Provide functional support, including issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
	+ Perform configuration updates and support data corrections where required.
	+ Support critical business cycles such as month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close.
* Upgrade Planning \& Release Readiness
	+ Perform regression testing and validate upgrade readiness across ERP workstreams.
	+ Partner with technical teams to review release notes, deprecations, and feature enablement.
	+ Validate fixes and confirm business sign\-off prior to production deployments.

jobs.description:
WorkWave is seeking a highly analytical and results\-driven **Revenue Operations Analyst** to be a core driver of our revenue engine's efficiency and predictability. This role is responsible for transforming complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that support our entire Go\-To\-Market (GTM) leadership team.

The ideal candidate will be an expert in data modeling, live in Excel and BI tools, and play a key role in annual planning, performance measurement, and providing high\-urgency strategic analysis for the CRO, CEO, and Board.
### **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Data Analysis \& Insights:** Analyze core metrics (pipeline health, bookings, retention/churn, product usage, and ARR trends) to identify risks, opportunities, and performance drivers. Perform detailed cohort, segmentation, and funnel analysis.
* **Reporting \& Dashboarding:** Own the creation and maintenance of executive\-level dashboards (Salesforce, Looker/Tableau, or equivalent). Produce weekly business reviews, monthly KPI reports, and materials that support the C\-level and Board reporting process.
* **Forecasting \& Modeling:** Support the bookings forecast process and ensure sales data integrity within the CRM. Maintain and refine predictive models for capacity planning, rep productivity, territory performance, and support quota\-setting exercises.
* **Cross\-Functional Reporting Support:** Partner with Sales Management, Marketing Ops, CS Ops, and Product Ops to unify data sources and workflows (Salesforce, Pendo, Gainsight, Marketo, Snowflake, etc.). Ensure consistent data definitions and reporting standards across functions to support end\-to\-end funnel attribution.
* **Annual and Quarterly Planning:** Provide data\-driven insights to support annual and quarterly GTM initiatives, including quota\-setting, territory modeling, and headcount planning.
* **Process Measurement \& Optimization:** Measure the impact of new processes and enablement programs. Track KPI performance, identify GTM process breakdowns, and recommend operational changes to enhance efficiency and productivity.

### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Prior experience supporting sales organizations with complex, multi\-product solution offerings.
* Familiarity with enterprise software or subscription business models.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Product Management (Warehouse Management Systems)
jobs.description:
Lineage is the largest and most dynamic temperature\-controlled warehousing \& logistics company in the world, reimagining the global food supply chain to eliminate waste and help feed the world. We are a trusted, innovative partner to our customers, connecting them to communities worldwide with
  

efficient supply chain solutions that preserve and protect food.
  

Our Product Management team drives this vision by leading Lineage's technology transformation \- changing how customers and partners engage, how warehouses operate, how energy is used, and how food is processed and transported. We define, design, develop, and deliver transformative technology
  

products that modernize the food supply chain through data\-driven insights, intuitive digital experiences, and resilient solutions deployed at scale.
  

Role Overview
  

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to assist our Product team in the development and execution of our proprietary Warehouse Management System (Connect). This system is the backbone of our operations and a cornerstone of Lineage's technology and productivity strategy. In this role, you will
  

help shape the future of Connect, making it the premier WMS for temperature\-controlled environments globally.
  

You will work with a talented product team, collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive innovation that impacts the entire food supply chain.**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with stakeholders and functional leaders to understand business requirements, generate functional specifications, and create detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs).
* Analyzes existing business processes, uses cases, and flows of data to define system behavior and interactions from a user perspective.
* Architect and document a functional solution that meets the product requirements including workflows, user interactions, and data flows.
* Collaborate with the UX Design team to create wireframes for proposed solutions and ensure cohesive and scalable product designs.


• Align acceptance criteria with stakeholders and work with the QA Engineering team to generate test cases that confirm the acceptance criteria has been met. • Work with cross\-functional teams to develop business cases for the opportunities within your area \- including ROI estimates, effort sizing, and risk assessments \- to support investment decisions.

* Conduct post\-deployment impact analyses to validate projected ROI and identify areas of opportunities.
* Collaborate with Technical Designers to define the technical execution of functional solutions.
* Facilitate communication with internal stakeholders to discuss future initiatives and enhancements to our systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, strategy operations, or a similar analytical role.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Domain experience with warehouse management or similar systems.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools is important.
* Strong relationship\-building skills with engineering, design, leadership, and internal \& external stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to interact with all levels of the organization and convey concepts \& results to a non\-technical audience.
* Highly organized and comfortable in a fast\-paced, highly visible, and changing environment.
* Ability to travel as needed; up to 20% of the time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in temperature controlled logistics or supply chains.
* Familiarity with Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence) and analytical tools (SQL, Excel).
* Background in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) preferred.
* Experience in Connect Warehouse Management System.

**Why Join Us?**

At Lineage, you'll have the opportunity to make a global impact by transforming the food supply chain. You'll work on cutting\-edge technology, collaborate with industry leaders, and help shape the future of logistics and warehousing.


\#LI\-Remote


Why Lineage?  

This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers' requirements. Beyond that, you'll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We'll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members.


Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law.  

Benefits


Lineage provides safe, stable, reliable work environments, medical, dental, and basic life and disability insurance benefits, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, annual bonus eligibility, and a minimum of 7 holidays throughout the calendar year.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.


At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of Operatev — Inizio Evoke's enterprise AI platform — from the inside out.


This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for keeping the program on schedule and its status transparent. You'll own the connective tissue: sequencing work across Product, Development, Change \& Enablement, Support, Operations, Business Transformation, and Commercialization so that nothing blocks on an unowned handoff and everyone is working from the same picture of where things stand.


You will sit at the center of a program that is building and rolling out a platform to 1,200 people. That means competing priorities, real dependencies, and a delivery pace that doesn't slow down. You will bring strong program management fundamentals in a product development environment, thrive on clarity and structure, and know how to translate complex cross\-functional realities into reporting that actually drives decisions.


This is a remote role reporting to the Program Lead.

  



**What You'll Do:**


***Own Cross\-Team Sequencing***


* Map dependencies across functions — what depends on what, in what order — and monitor progress against that sequence
* Ensure handoffs are owned, surface unresolved blockers early, and drive items to closure or escalation
* Maintain visibility into the implications of sequencing decisions for Product, Development, and all downstream functions

***Run the Quarterly Planning Cycle***


* Gather functional inputs across all workstreams
* Facilitate commitment\-setting and document outcomes
* Translate quarterly commitments into trackable milestones and hold functions accountable to them

***Track Program Resourcing***


* Maintain visibility into where capacity is going against what's committed and manage the program's calendar to proactively address capacity challenges
* Surface trends and anomalies to program leadership before they become problems
* Oversee recruitment process, meeting with talent acquisition for updates and ensuring timely progress through stakeholder participation

***Set and Hold Stage Gate Standards***


* Define the gates work passes through and what evidence clears each one
* Keep functional cadences in sync without taking over internal functional processes (sprint practices, capability lifecycle, etc.)

***Run Delivery Forums***


* Facilitate the weekly initiative update and risk review
* Maintain the risk register and drive items to resolution or escalation
* Track progress against quarterly commitments and hold the reporting cadence

***Define Reporting Standards***


* Establish and maintain the data taxonomy that governs how each function reports its metrics
* Ensure functional outputs roll into one consistent program\-level picture rather than competing narratives

***Own Executive Reporting***


* Prepare and deliver the synthesized program view for executive and steering committee audiences
* Surface where delivery reality constrains what's being asked — clearly and with context

  

**What You'll Bring:**


* 7\+ years of experience in program management, delivery management, or PMO leadership — ideally within a technology platform, transformation, or product delivery context
* Experience running formal planning cycles (quarterly or release\-based) and translating outputs into trackable commitments
* Track record of building and maintaining executive\-level reporting that is trusted and acted on
* Comfortable managing budget and resource visibility — not ownership, but accurate tracking and surfacing of variance
* Background in professional services, agency, consulting, or regulated industry preferred (healthcare, life sciences, or similar)

***Skills***


* Strong program and project management fundamentals — dependency mapping, risk management, stage gates, and cadence management
* Highly organized: you make things visible, structured, and easy to act on
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complexity into clean reporting without losing accuracy
* Comfortable operating in agile/iterative environments where priorities shift and the plan evolves
* Skilled facilitator — able to run productive cross\-functional forums without letting them drift

***Mindset***


* You keep things moving without needing to own everything
* You surface problems early and bring them forward with enough context for a decision
* You enforce standards consistently — not rigidly, but reliably
* You understand the difference between tracking and deciding, and you stay in your lane while making it easy for others to stay in theirs

  

**What We Offer**


* A central, high\-impact role in a program building something genuinely new — an enterprise AI platform designed to change how a 1,200\-person agency does its work
* Direct visibility to executive and steering committee leadership
* A cross\-functional operating environment where your work touches every part of the program
* The opportunity to define and own the operating standards that the program runs on

Inizio Evoke provides an exciting and flexible work environment, great compensation packages and outstanding company paid benefits including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement and flexible time off.

jobs.title: Program Manager, JCC Maccabi
jobs.description:
Program Manager, JCC Maccabi  

JCC Association  

520 8th Ave  

\#1204  

New York, NY 10018
**Principal Responsibilities:**
===============================


**Position:** Program Manager, JCC Maccabi


**Team:** JCC Maccabi


**Reports to:** Program Director, JCC Maccabi


**Summary**
-----------


JCC Maccabi(r) is a signature program of the JCC Movement. Established in 1982, the JCC Maccabi(r) Games have brought together more than 150,000 teens and more than 500,000 host families, volunteers, and spectators for one\-week annual Olympic\-style events in host communities throughout North America. The program connects teens, JCCs, and communities from across North America and around the world to explore their Jewish identities, develop lasting memories, friendships, and connections, and make a difference in the Jewish world of today and of the future.


JCC Association of North America seeks an enthusiastic and dynamic professional to serve as Program Manager on the JCC Maccabi team. Reporting to the Program Director, this full\-time position provides high\-level administrative, operational, programmatic, and organizational support to the JCC Maccabi program.


Successful candidates are dedicated and competent professionals with strong verbal and written skills; are highly organized, detail\-oriented, hard\-working, and capable of tackling multiple projects at a time; and are comfortable in customer\- and stakeholder\-facing roles in addition to enjoying "back\-end" support, digital, and data management work. They work well independently but also thrive as committed members of a team in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, while maintaining a high level of professionalism and integrity.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


**Program Support**


*Support the JCC Maccabi program in ensuring strong, well\-resourced delegations and progress toward participation goals, including delivering high\-quality training and support for Delegation Heads and coaches, and helping build a positive, well\-organized experience for every JCC Maccabi delegation.*


Responsibilities include:


* Serve as a Delegation Head (DH) liaison, providing DHs across the field with monthly trainings and resources to support successful athlete recruitment and delegation management for the JCC Maccabi Games.
* Assist in designing, managing, and delivering DH and coach trainings, webinars, and supporting resources to help ensure the success of each JCC Maccabi delegation.
* Coordinate the Delegation Head Mentor/Mentee Program, connecting first\- and second\-year DHs with veteran DHs to guide them through recruitment and preparation for the JCC Maccabi Games.
* Support the Program Director in developing and stewarding organizational collaborations and partnerships.
* Under the direction of the Program Director, work to develop new programmatic initiatives (e.g., Jr. Maccabi, alumni engagement, year\-round teen programming, and partnerships).
* Develop and implement curriculum for the JCC Maccabi Teen International Leadership Board, made up of teenage JCC Maccabi athletes and alumni, to build leadership abilities, gather input on shaping the JCC Maccabi program, and develop skills in team collaboration, communication, and relationship building.
* Develop and deliver program surveys and support evaluation strategy and implementation.
* Assist in cross\-functional collaboration within JCC Association departments (e.g., program departments, marketing, finance, CRM implementation).
* With support from the Program Director, build a continental delegation (the J\-Team) when needed by recruiting or re\-engaging athletes, coaches, and volunteers, and play a lead role in all associated operational and programmatic efforts, including overseeing and managing logistics related to registration, travel, uniforms and swag, and sport\-specific positions.

**Administrative and Operational Support**

* Develop resources for the JCC Resource Center and Delegation Toolkit.
* Support the process of DH and coach training.
* Work with the Program Director to cultivate new strategies for efficient administration and program support.
* Manage program merchandising, including research, pricing, ordering, inventorying, and shipping program supplies.
* Assist with other duties as assigned.
* Provide on\-the\-ground support during the week(s) of JCC Maccabi to host communities, DHs, and the JCC Maccabi staff team.
* Interact and communicate with the host community, delegation heads and coaches, JCC Association team, parents, coaches, and athletes to help ensure a safe and positive experience for all participants.
* Oversee the smooth running of the J\-Team when needed


**At the Games**

* Provide on\-the\-ground support during the week(s) of JCC Maccabi to host communities, DHs, and the JCC Maccabi staff team.
* Interact and communicate with the host community, delegation heads and coaches, JCC Association team, parents, coaches, and athletes to help ensure a safe and positive experience for all participants.
* Oversee the smooth running of the J\-Team when needed

**Travel**


* Some travel anticipated throughout the year for site visits, Spring DH Meeting, and other JCC Association related events and gatherings as assigned.
* Travel to the host community for the week(s) of JCC Maccabi each summer (see "At the Games" above).
* Some periodic travel to New York headquarters (if a remote employee).

**Compensation and Benefits**


JCC Association offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including:


* Salary Range: $65,000\-$75,000 annual
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Eight paid legal holidays and up to 13 paid Jewish holidays. In addition, the office closes early on the eve of three Jewish holidays.

* Experience in financial services, regulatory compliance, anti\-money laundering, transaction monitoring, or related domain.

Leidos is seeking an experienced IT Project Manager who is interested in supporting large information technology projects for our Utility Technologies Solutions team. In this role, you will drive the execution and delivery of IT projects supporting electric utility operations, technology modernization, and evolving grid initiatives for our utility client. Lightpath is building the fiber infrastructure the digital economy depends on \- owning, operating, and expanding dense, high\-performance networks for enterprises, public institutions, carriers, and cloud innovators. The Senior Project Manager serves as the primary customer\-facing lead throughout the implementation lifecycle and is accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations.

* Ownership and accountability for project outcomes.
* Strong customer focus and sense of urgency.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proactive risk management and issue resolution.
* Effective collaboration across cross\-functional teams.

* Manage project scope, change requests, dependencies, and customer expectations.

Required Skills \& Competencies

  


* Strong project management, scheduling, and organizational skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Working knowledge of telecommunications services and implementation practices.

**Job Description**  

The Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) leverages technology to drive opportunity, improve public safety, and help government run better across New York City. From delivering affordable broadband to protecting against cybersecurity threats and building digital government services, OTI is at the forefront of how the city delivers for New Yorkers in the 21st century. Follow us on social media @NYCOfficeofTech, and visit www.nyc.gov/oti to learn more.  

  

At OTI, we offer great benefits, and the chance to work on projects that have a meaningful impact on millions of people. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and collaborate with other passionate professionals who share your drive and commitment to making a difference through technology.  

  

Job Description  

Establishing a baseline for Citywide cyber defense is a complex multi\-year endeavor. It involves the design, build, implementation, and operation of net\-new people, processes, and technology. As cybersecurity threats become more numerous and more sophisticated, the defense of the City’s information systems and critical service delivery vehicles becomes more important, time consuming, and specialized. The design of systems which function at the required level of efficacy, usability, and speed is a major engineering undertaking.  

  

A seasoned project manager is required to support Cyber Command leadership in the management and optimization of its portfolio of established citywide cybersecurity programs and evolving suite of cybersecurity controls deployment. These programs have significant complexity across many City agencies, stakeholders, other cybersecurity entities in government and the private sector, and our information\-sharing partners.

jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**


adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.  

  

Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next\-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.  

  

Our award\-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.

##### **The Role**


We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Finance team, dedicated to marketplace operations. The right person is passionate about connecting the dots between financial performance, day\-to\-day operational execution, and the underlying supply/demand dynamics that drive our marketplace. You'll sit inside Finance but work hands\-on with Operations (Demand Ops, Supply Ops, Campaign Management) and Pricing \& Yield, turning disparate operational and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.


This role gives you a dedicated seat inside marketplace operations while reporting through Finance — visibility across the business that few analyst roles offer.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the dedicated data analyst embedded in marketplace operations, working day\-to\-day with Demand Ops, Supply Ops, and Campaign Management while reporting through FP\&A.
* Analyze marketplace dynamics — supply/demand balance, pricing trends, yield, and competitive positioning — to surface insights that inform operational and revenue decisions.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and build reporting that improves day\-to\-day decision\-making across the teams you support.
* Build and maintain models and dashboards that unify financial and operational data, reducing manual reporting effort over time.
* Translate complex, cross\-functional analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership, including financial impact, tradeoffs, and risk.
* Support scenario planning and variance analysis tying operational drivers to financial outcomes.
* Identify emerging trends across the marketplace and proactively flag risks or opportunities before they materially affect performance.
* Establish and document best practices for analytical rigor and reporting consistency between Finance and Operations.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, BI, CS, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related analytical role.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning analytical projects and translating findings into measurable business outcomes.
* Proven ability to organize and analyze large datasets, identify trends, and translate complex analyses into clear business recommendations.
* Experience developing forecasting or analytical models and evaluating their performance over time.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, lookups, etc.).
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
* Experience building dashboards using Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar BI platforms.
* Experience with Python or other scripting languages is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical thinking, business judgment, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.
* Experience in digital advertising, marketplace businesses, e\-commerce, fintech, or related industries is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Compensation:** $80,000 – $90,000 \+ Bonus \& Equity

adMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s\- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team!


We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company\-wide lunch and learns, and well\-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow.

We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon's Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day\-to\-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution\-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.  

  

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands\-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support
  

* Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
* Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
* Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

  

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration
  

* Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
* Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
* Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

  

Reporting and Analytics Support
  

* Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
* Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
* Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
* Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

  

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement
  

* Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
* Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how\-to materials.

  

What Success Looks Like
  

* Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
* Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
* CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
* Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly.
* Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go\-to\-market operations.

  

Preferred  

* Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
* Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
* Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

  

Ideal Candidate  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service\-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.  

  

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.  

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  

  

**Additional Information**  

**When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together.** We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30\+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

The CSM is responsible for the leadership development of the individuals who report to them, while also being accountable for the delivery of security operations at these locations. The Campus Security Manager (CSM) leads a team of site security personnel, including site managers, field training officers, and security officers, and is accountable for delivering physical security\-related services at one or more assigned locations within a geographic area. The CSM is responsible for the leadership development of the individuals who report to them, while also being accountable for the delivery of security operations at these locations. jobs.description:
**Job description**

**A Meaningful Opportunity to Join Homestretch**

**Financial Wellness Program Manager**

**30\-40 hours per week (salary range based on 40 hours per week, commensurate with experience and skill set)**

*Due to organizational growth and the retirement of a long\-serving team member, this position is now available for the first time following over 20 years of dedicated service to Homestretch.*

*This is an exciting opportunity to join a stable, mission\-driven organization and build upon a role that has made a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals and families experiencing housing instability. We are looking for someone who is ready to bring their financial expertise, compassion, creativity, and commitment to a new chapter of this important work.*

***About Homestretch***

*Homestretch supports individuals and families experiencing housing instability as they work toward long\-term housing stability, financial security, and greater independence. We recognize that financial challenges are often connected to larger systemic barriers and experiences of poverty, housing instability, trauma, and limited access to resources.*

*Our approach is trauma\-informed, person\-centered, strengths\-based, and rooted in dignity and respect. We meet people where they are, recognize the strengths and expertise they bring to their own lives, and partner with families to identify practical goals and pathways forward.*

**The Opportunity**

Homestretch is seeking a **Financial Wellness Program Manager** to provide individualized financial coaching and support to families working toward financial stability.

This position works alongside clients to navigate credit, debt, savings, banking, budgeting, taxes, benefits, and other financial concerns. The goal is not simply to teach financial skills—it is to partner with each family in developing realistic strategies that reflect their goals, circumstances, strengths, and priorities.

The Financial Wellness Program Manager will also coordinate Homestretch's debt repayment and savings programs and collaborate closely with case management, employment, child services, and other program staff. The Financial Wellness Program Manager will have an opportunity to grow the program to include an additional financial/credit counselor.

**Provide Individualized Financial Coaching**

* Develop an individualized financial wellness plan with each family, including budgeting, money management, banking, debt repayment, savings, and other financial goals.
* Meet regularly with clients to review progress, identify changing needs, celebrate successes, and adjust strategies as circumstances change.
* Support clients in building financial knowledge, confidence, and skills at their own pace.
* Help clients understand their financial options without judgment and support them in making informed decisions that align with their goals.
* Communicate relevant client needs and progress with members of the direct services team while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and respect for client privacy.

**Support Credit, Debt, and Banking Goals**

* Obtain and review credit histories and tenant screening/background information as appropriate to program needs.
* Work collaboratively with clients to identify and prioritize outstanding debts.
* Assist clients with credit bureau disputes and work with creditors when appropriate to explore debt settlement or repayment options.
* Develop strategies to establish or rebuild credit.
* Support clients in opening and maintaining checking and savings accounts and developing sustainable banking practices.
* Track credit scores and debt repayment activity in the Access database.

**Coordinate Financial Programs**

* Coordinate Homestretch's debt repayment and savings programs.
* Prepare client payments to creditors and communicate payment information to the bookkeeper.
* Maintain accurate subsidiary ledgers for client debt repayment and savings accounts and reconcile balances monthly.
* Prepare and distribute monthly statements related to client deposits, savings, and debt repayment.

**Connect Clients to Resources**

* Help clients navigate employment benefits, public benefits, health insurance marketplace enrollment, hospital financial assistance, W\-4 forms, and other financial resources.
* Research options and resources related to specific client expenses and needs.
* Provide information and referrals that expand clients' access to financial and community resources.

**Support Tax Preparation**

* Manage Homestretch's Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) site.
* Track the status of client tax refunds and assist clients in addressing federal and state tax issues.
* Partner with clients to consider their goals and priorities when planning how tax refunds may best support their financial stability.

**Job Summary**



The Business Analyst will be responsible for developing and delivering mission critical new software applications for the CRISP Health Information Exchange. The Business Analyst will be an excellent verbal and written communicator, will have an attention to detail, the ability to solve coordinate with a number of stakeholders, manage priorities, and the ability to identify and resolve problems. The Business Analyst plays a critical role on the software development team to ensure delivered products meet requirements.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**



Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  


* Works with the Analysts and other stakeholders on requirements gathering and scoping for product Features
* Refines features so that the development team can clearly understand what is being developed
* Identifies spike opportunities for the given features
* Defines user stories for the features, including writing Acceptance Criteria for the Devs and QAs, and ensure stories meet the Definition of Ready
* Communicate any changes in requirements following Requirements Review Board (RRB) approval to appropriate stakeholders
* Ensure that the development team backlog is in priority order
* Regularly participant in Scrum process  

	+ Facilitates Scrum meetings (Daily Scrum, Grooming, Planning, Review, and Retrospective)
	+ Keep track of the team’s capacity, velocity, and predictability
	+ Work with the team to refine and groom stories
	+ Plan sprints based on the team’s current capacity
	+ Review Test Plans for stories before closing items, ensuring all items are meeting the Definition of Done
* Attempts to remove any blockers from the team, if unable to remove blockers, and reaches out to the leadership to escalate any issues blocking the team
* Take ownership of overall success of the service
* Assist in the transition of developed services to operations teams (DevOps, App Support)
	+ Together with Leads and Analysts: Determine appropriate Release timelines
	+ Handoff Release items to Release Manager to push through deployment and validation progress
* Ensures that the teams stay on track to reach quarterly goals

  


**Qualifications**



To perform this job successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  


* Ability to quickly understand and take ownership of business processes and product development plans
* Ability to work with many different stakeholders and subject matter experts from different backgrounds (clinical, business, technical)
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology, particularly with the Product Owner role and with writing User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Comfortable working in fast paced environment with changing priorities
* Experience with writing and executing test cases a plus
* Take pride in delivering software that meets the client’s needs
* Knowledge of Agile incremental development methods
* Demonstrated ability to work well on a diverse team
* Experience writing requirements for REST APIs and/or SOAP web services, GRPC a plus
* Experience testing APIs via Postman or similar tool
* Experience creating wireframes or mockups through tools such as Figma or Balsamiq preferred
* Experience with Jira as management tool preferred
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure preferred

  


**Experience and/or Education Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in IT or business field
* Minimum 2\-3 years in a Business Analyst position or similar role with a software development team

**Compensation and Benefits Package**


* Targeted base salary: $90k \- $105k per year, based on experience and qualifications, plus benefits and bonuses.
* Benefits include the following but are not limited to health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance. CSS also has a 403(b) plan with discretionary employer match and contributions. You will be eligible for 20 days of Paid Time Off per year (accrued in accordance with CSS' policies). PTO is in addition to 8 company designated holidays. If you are not PTO eligible, you may be eligible for applicable state and/or local sick and safe leave in accordance with the provisions of any applicable state and/or local sick and safe leave laws.

  


**Website:** www.crispsharedservices.org


**Location:** Hybrid, Columbia, MD (Open to remote candidates)
